simple.prompt: By the time the manager arrived, they ___ for over three hours.
simple.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing) digunakan untuk menekankan durasi aksi yang sedang berlangsung sebelum titik waktu tertentu di masa lampau.
hints: Menekankan durasi aksi lampau sebelum peristiwa lampau lain.
Formula: had been + V-ing.

simple.prompt: His eyes were red and weary because he ___ all night on the server migration.
simple.explanation: Menjelaskan bukti/akibat fisik di masa lalu (eyes were red) dari aktivitas yang baru saja berlangsung terus-menerus.
hints: Bukti lampau (eyes were red) akibat aktivitas terus-menerus.
Gunakan 'had been working'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Perfect Continuous dengan durasi waktu.
simple.targetSentence: She had been studying Japanese before moving to Tokyo.
simple.explanation: Subject + had been studying + Japanese + before moving to Tokyo.
hints: Mulai dengan 'She had been studying Japanese'.
Keterangan waktu: 'before moving to Tokyo'.

simple.prompt: How long ___ before the bus finally arrived?
simple.explanation: Bentuk interogatif: How long + had + subjek + been + V-ing.
hints: Pertanyaan durasi sebelum peristiwa lampau.
Gunakan 'had you been waiting'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif Past Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: They had not been working on that project for long.
simple.explanation: Subject + had not been working + on that project + for long.
hints: Bentuk negatif: 'They had not been working'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'on that project for long'.

simple.prompt: The ground was wet because it ___ heavily throughout the afternoon.
simple.explanation: 'Had been raining' menjelaskan penyebab dari kondisi masa lampau ('the ground was wet').
hints: Aksi berlangsung terus-menerus yang menjelaskan kondisi lampau.
Gunakan 'had been raining'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan time marker 'for two hours'.
simple.targetSentence: We had been driving for two hours when the engine failed.
simple.explanation: We had been driving for two hours + when the engine failed.
hints: Aksi berkelanjutan: 'We had been driving for two hours'.
Interupsi: 'when the engine failed'.

simple.prompt: By the time the ferry finally docked, passengers ___ waiting in the lounge for two hours.
simple.explanation: Aktivitas berdurasi yang berlangsung sebelum titik waktu lampau ('finally docked') memakai Past Perfect Continuous ('had been waiting').
hints: Ada aksi berdurasi ('for two hours') sebelum momen lampau 'docked'.
Rumus dasar: had been + V-ing.

simple.prompt: How long had the courier ___ trying to reach the loading bay before security opened the gate?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Perfect Continuous mengikuti pola 'Had + S + been + V-ing?'.
hints: Setelah 'had + subject', sisipkan past participle 'been'.
Perhatikan V-ing 'trying' setelahnya.

simple.prompt: Her shoulders felt stiff because she ___ drafting architecture schematics all afternoon.
simple.explanation: Penyebab kelelahan yang tampak pada momen lampau ('felt stiff') akibat aktivitas panjang sebelumnya menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous ('had been drafting').
hints: Titik acuannya lampau ('felt stiff').
Sebab berdurasi sebelum kondisi lampau memakai 'had been + V-ing'.

simple.prompt: We ___ been negotiating for ten minutes before both teams agreed on a delivery window.
simple.explanation: Durasi aktivitas ('for ten minutes') sebelum peristiwa lampau ('agreed') membutuhkan auxiliary 'had'.
hints: Ada kata kerja 'agreed' (lampau) dan 'been negotiating'.
Lengkapi dengan 'had'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang kondisi masa lampau.
dialogue: Manager
Why did the backup generator smell warm yesterday morning?
Technician
It ___ continuously since the midnight power dip.
simple.explanation: Kejadian kemarin pagi ('yesterday morning') akibat aktivitas yang terus berjalan dari tengah malam sebelumnya memakai Past Perfect Continuous ('had been running').
hints: Seluruh peristiwa terjadi kemarin.
Aksi terus berjalan sebelum pemeriksaan pagi memakai 'had been running'.

simple.prompt: They hadn't ___ rehearsing for very long when the microphone battery died.
simple.explanation: Bentuk negatif Past Perfect Continuous adalah 'hadn't been + V-ing'.
hints: Cari komponen yang hilang di antara 'hadn't' dan 'rehearsing'.
Past participle setelah 'hadn't' adalah 'been'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan bentuk lampau dan kini pada kalimat berdurasi berikut.
simple.draft: Before moving to Surabaya last year, Dani has been teaching coding in Malang for four years.
options: Before moving to Surabaya last year, Dani had been teaching coding in Malang for four years.
Before moving to Surabaya last year, Dani was been teaching coding in Malang for four years.
Before moving to Surabaya last year, Dani had being teaching coding in Malang for four years.
simple.explanation: Karena titik batas waktunya 'last year' (lampau), aktivitas berdurasi sebelum itu memakai Past Perfect Continuous ('had been teaching'), bukan Present Perfect Continuous ('has been').
hints: 'Last year' menjadi patokan lampau.
Ubah 'has been' menjadi 'had been'.

simple.prompt: The kitchen floor was wet because someone ___ mopping right before lunch.
simple.explanation: Bukti fisik di masa lampau ('was wet') dijelaskan oleh aktivitas berdurasi tepat sebelum saat itu ('had been mopping').
hints: Kondisi lampau 'was wet' disebabkan aktivitas sebelumnya.
Pilih 'had been'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Perfect Continuous berdurasi dengan 'for'.
simple.targetSentence: The researchers had been analyzing coastal water samples for six weeks before publishing.
simple.explanation: Subjek + had been + V-ing + objek + durasi + before clause.
hints: Awali dengan 'The researchers had been analyzing'.
Akhiri dengan 'for six weeks before publishing'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Past Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: Had you been waiting outside long before the receptionist unlocked the door?
hints: Mulai pertanyaan dengan 'Had you been waiting'.
Lengkapi dengan 'before the receptionist unlocked the door?'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk tenses yang membedakan proses (continuous) vs hasil selesai (simple).
dialogue: Lead Auditor
Why was the balance sheet still incomplete at midnight?
Associate
Because we ___ discrepancies in the ledger all evening.
intermediate.explanation: Associate menekankan proses investigasi yang terus berlangsung dan melelahkan sepanjang malam ('had been investigating').
hints: Menekankan proses dan usaha berkelanjutan.
Gunakan Past Perfect Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Stative verb constraint: 'Prior to the 2020 merger, the two executives ___ each other for decades.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Know' adalah stative verb (tidak bisa continuous). Maka wajib menggunakan Past Perfect Simple ('had known'), bukan continuous.
hints: 'Know' adalah stative verb.
Stative verb tidak boleh menggunakan bentuk continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Contrast: 'He ___ the novel before the deadline.' (completed result)
intermediate.explanation: Untuk hasil yang selesai sempurna (completed result / quantity), gunakan Past Perfect Simple ('had written').
hints: Menyatakan penyelesaian/output final.
Gunakan Past Perfect Simple.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan stative verb 'had belonged'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The antique watch had belonged to his grandfather for fifty years.
intermediate.explanation: 'Belong' adalah kata kerja stative, gunakan Past Perfect Simple meskipun ada durasi 'for fifty years'.
hints: 'Belong' adalah stative verb.
Gunakan 'had belonged'.

intermediate.prompt: Interrupted action: 'The team ___ on the prototype when the power grid collapsed.'
intermediate.explanation: Menjelaskan aktivitas produktif yang sedang berjalan sebelum diinterupsi oleh pemadaman listrik.
hints: Aktivitas berjalan sebelum titik putus masa lalu.
Gunakan 'had been collaborating'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun dialog tanya jawab tentang durasi kerja.
intermediate.targetSentence: How long had you been living abroad before returning?
intermediate.explanation: How long had you been living abroad + before returning?
hints: Mulai dengan 'How long had you been living abroad'.
Klausa waktu: 'before returning?'.

dialogue: Director
Did they manage to fix the security breach quickly?
Security Chief
No, hackers ___ into our database for weeks before detection.
intermediate.explanation: Aksi infiltrasi berjalan berulang/kontinu selama berminggu-minggu sebelum disadari ('had been infiltrating').
hints: Aktivitas rahasia yang berlangsung kontinu selama berminggu-minggu.
Gunakan Past Perfect Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Compare focus: 'By 5 p.m., she ___ fifteen client calls' (completed count) vs 'By 5 p.m., she ___ calls non-stop since noon' (ongoing effort).
intermediate.explanation: Penyebutan jumlah tuntas ('fifteen client calls') wajib memakai Past Perfect Simple ('had answered'); penekanan pada usaha/proses berdurasi ('non-stop since noon') memakai Past Perfect Continuous ('had been answering').
hints: Kuantitas hasil selesai memakai Simple; durasi proses terus-menerus memakai Continuous.
Cocokkan masing-masing klausa dengan sifat objeknya.

intermediate.prompt: The customs system ___ smoothly until an overnight certificate update triggered timeouts.
intermediate.explanation: Aktivitas aktif yang berlangsung stabil hingga saat insiden lampau ('triggered') memakai bentuk aktif 'had been running'.
hints: Subjek 'The customs system' berjalan aktif ('running'), bukan pasif.
Gunakan 'had been running'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang kesalahan memakai stative verb dalam Past Perfect Continuous.
dialogue: Student
Why can't I write 'Before 2020, they had been knowing each other for ten years'?
Tutor
Because 'know' is a stative verb — replace it with ___!
intermediate.explanation: Kata kerja keadaan ('know', 'own', 'believe', 'belong') tidak menerima bentuk '-ing', sehingga durasi sebelum titik lampau memakai Past Perfect Simple ('had known').
hints: 'Know' tidak boleh memakai '-ing'.
Durasi stative sebelum masa lampau memakai 'had + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Our field crew was soaked to the bone; they ___ clearing storm drains since dawn.
intermediate.explanation: Bukti fisik lampau ('was soaked') disebabkan oleh pekerjaan berdurasi dari subuh sebelum saat itu ('had been clearing').
hints: To be 'was soaked' menandai sudut pandang lampau.
Lengkapi dengan 'had been'.

intermediate.prompt: Before the bridge reopened last spring, commuters ___ detours for nearly fourteen months.
intermediate.explanation: Aktivitas rutin yang berlangsung selama 14 bulan sebelum jembatan dibuka kembali di masa lalu memakai 'had been taking'.
hints: Titik akhir durasi adalah 'last spring' (lampau).
Durasi berulang sebelum titik lampau memakai 'had been taking'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penggabungan stative verb 'belong' ke bentuk continuous berikut.
intermediate.draft: Prior to the 2019 acquisition, that historic warehouse had been belonging to a textile guild.
options: Prior to the 2019 acquisition, that historic warehouse had belonged to a textile guild.
Prior to the 2019 acquisition, that historic warehouse has belonged to a textile guild.
Prior to the 2019 acquisition, that historic warehouse was belonging to a textile guild.
intermediate.explanation: 'Belong' adalah stative verb kepemilikan tetap yang tidak pernah dipakai dalam bentuk '-ing'; gunakan Past Perfect Simple ('had belonged').
hints: 'Belong' termasuk stative verb kepemilikan.
Ubah ke bentuk Past Perfect Simple 'had belonged'.

intermediate.prompt: We ___ hoping to catch the 6:15 express, yet heavy congestion forced us to rebook.
intermediate.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous dengan 'hope/plan' ('had been hoping to...') mengekspresikan harapan berdurasi di masa lampau sebelum batal/berubah.
hints: Konteksnya lampau ('forced us to rebook').
Pakai 'had been' + 'hoping'.

intermediate.prompt: How many prototypes had your team ___ before finalizing the waterproof casing?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan berfokus pada jumlah benda yang selesai dibuat ('How many prototypes') memakai Past Perfect Simple ('had ... built'), bukan Continuous.
hints: Kata kunci 'How many prototypes' menanyakan jumlah tuntas.
Gunakan V3 'built' (Past Perfect Simple).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang kontras dengan 'had been hoping' di masa lampau.
intermediate.targetSentence: Investors had been expecting higher margins until raw material costs spiked.
intermediate.explanation: Harapan yang terbangun berkelanjutan sebelum kejadian lampau memakai 'had been expecting'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Investors had been expecting higher margins'.
Sambungkan dengan 'until raw material costs spiked'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penyebab kelelahan lampau dengan 'because'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The interpreters looked exhausted because they had been translating live speeches all morning.
intermediate.explanation: Hasil tampak lampau ('looked exhausted') + sebab aktivitas panjang sebelumnya ('had been translating').
hints: Awali dengan 'The interpreters looked exhausted because'.
Pasangkan 'they had been translating live speeches all morning'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi penggunaan stative verb 'like' pada Past Perfect Continuous.
complex.draft: She had been liking classical music since she was a little girl.
options: She had liked classical music since she was a little girl.
She had been like classical music since she was a little girl.
She was liking classical music since she was a little girl.
complex.explanation: 'Like' adalah kata kerja emosi/status (stative). Tidak boleh dipakai dalam continuous ('had been liking' keliru). Wajib 'had liked'.
hints: 'Like' adalah stative verb.
Ganti dengan Past Perfect Simple: 'had liked'.

complex.prompt: Nuance distinction: 'She had been smoking for twenty years' vs 'She had smoked three cigarettes.' What dictates the choice?
options: Continuous emphasizes duration/activity; Simple emphasizes completed amount/quantity.
Continuous is informal; Simple is academic only.
complex.explanation: Continuous menekankan durasi/proses aktivitas ('for twenty years'), sedangkan Simple menekankan kuantitas/jumlah objek terselesaikan ('three cigarettes').
hints: Perhatikan perbedaan proses vs jumlah hasil terselesaikan.
Pilih opsi penjelasan durasi vs jumlah.

complex.prompt: In formal narrative exposition: 'The diplomatic envoy ___ rumors of rebellion for months before formal hostilities commenced.'
complex.explanation: Dalam narasi sejarah formal, 'had been monitoring' menunjukkan pengawasan berkelanjutan sebelum pecahnya perang.
hints: Pengawasan kontinu masa lalu.
Gunakan 'had been monitoring'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat analitis laporan kegagalan teknis.
complex.targetSentence: The cooling system had been malfunctioning intermittently for days.
complex.explanation: Subject + had been malfunctioning + intermittently (adverb) + for days (duration).
hints: Mulai dengan 'The cooling system had been malfunctioning'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'intermittently for days'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki tenses pada klausa waktu sebelum titik lampau.
complex.draft: By 2018, the research laboratory has been developing the vaccine for seven years.
options: By 2018, the research laboratory had been developing the vaccine for seven years.
By 2018, the research laboratory was developing the vaccine for seven years.
By 2018, the research laboratory would develop the vaccine for seven years.
complex.explanation: 'By 2018' adalah titik waktu lampau tertentu. Maka tenses durasi sebelum titik tersebut WAJIB Past Perfect Continuous ('had been developing'), bukan Present Perfect ('has been').
hints: 'By 2018' menandai batas waktu lampau.
Gunakan 'had been developing'.

complex.prompt: Which sentence correctly contrasts repeated action with continuous ongoing state?
options: They had been ringing the bell five times before someone answered. (Incorrect: quantity needs Simple)
They had rung the bell five times before someone answered. (Correct: specific quantity requires Simple)
They had been ringing the bell for five times. (Incorrect)
complex.explanation: Jika ada frekuensi terhitung spesifik ('five times'), gunakan Past Perfect Simple ('had rung'), bukan continuous.
hints: Jumlah hitungan spesifik (five times) memerlukan Simple.
Pilih kalimat 'had rung'.

dialogue: Inspector
What led to the catastrophic structural collapse?
Engineer
Vibrations from heavy machinery ___ the foundation walls for months.
complex.explanation: Getaran secara kumulatif dan berkelanjutan terus memperlemah dinding selama berbulan-bulan sebelum roboh ('had been weakening').
hints: Proses kumulatif berkelanjutan di masa lalu.
Gunakan 'had been weakening'.

complex.prompt: Why is Past Perfect Continuous preferred over Past Continuous in 'When the inspector arrived, the interns had been sorting files since eight'?
options: It specifies the duration elapsed right up to the moment of arrival
Past Continuous cannot be used with plural subjects
'Since eight' requires passive voice in the past
complex.explanation: Past Continuous ('were sorting') hanya memotret bahwa mereka sedang menyortir saat inspektur datang tanpa durasi; menambahkan 'since eight' / 'for three hours' menuntut Past Perfect Continuous untuk mengukur durasi yang telah berjalan hingga titik lampau tersebut.
hints: Perhatikan frasa durasi 'since eight'.
Mengukur durasi dari titik awal hingga momen lampau wajib memakai Past Perfect Continuous.

complex.prompt: Hardly ___ monitoring the pressure valve for ten minutes when the gauge suddenly dipped.
complex.explanation: Inversi negatif dengan 'Hardly' pada Past Perfect Continuous memindahkan auxiliary PERTAMA ('had') ke depan subjek: 'Hardly had + S + been + V-ing when...'.
hints: Hanya auxiliary pertama ('had') yang berpindah ke depan subjek dalam inversi.
Pertahankan 'been' tepat sebelum 'monitoring'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan menyisipkan adverb frekuensi dan menggunakan passive yang janggal pada kalimat durasi lampau berikut.
complex.draft: For weeks, local clinics had been being overwhelmed by seasonal flu appointments before mobile vans arrived.
options: For weeks, local clinics had been overwhelmed by seasonal flu appointments before mobile vans arrived.
For weeks, local clinics had overwhelmed by seasonal flu appointments before mobile vans arrived.
For weeks, local clinics have been overwhelmed by seasonal flu appointments before mobile vans arrived.
complex.explanation: Bahasa Inggris menghindari bentuk pasif 'had been being + V3' yang sangat canggung; gunakan Past Perfect Passive standar ('had been overwhelmed') meskipun ada durasi 'For weeks'.
hints: Hindari konstruksi ganda 'had been being'.
Past Perfect Passive yang alami cukup 'had been + V3'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang reported speech dari Present Perfect Continuous.
dialogue: Interviewer
How should I report Maya's statement: 'I have been auditing these logs since dawn'?
Editor
With past reporting verb 'Maya explained', backshift it to ___.
options: Maya explained that she had been auditing those logs since dawn.
Maya explained that she was auditing those logs since dawn.
Maya explained that she has been auditing those logs since dawn.
complex.explanation: Dalam reported speech dengan reporting verb lampau ('explained'), Present Perfect Continuous ('have been auditing') mundur secara alami menjadi Past Perfect Continuous ('had been auditing').
hints: Present Perfect Continuous mengalami backshift ke Past Perfect Continuous.
Ubah 'have been' menjadi 'had been'.

complex.prompt: Notice how punctual repeated actions work: 'The sensor ___ dropping packets intermittently for an hour before IT swapped the router.'
complex.explanation: Aksi singkat ('drop a packet') yang terjadi berulang-ulang selama kurun waktu tertentu sebelum momen lampau ('before IT swapped') memakai 'had been + V-ing'.
hints: Aksi berulang selama satu jam sebelum tindakan IT di masa lampau.
Pilih 'had been'.

complex.prompt: Only after the crew ___ excavating for three weeks did they uncover the intact ceramic kiln.
complex.explanation: Di dalam klausa 'Only after...', durasi 3 minggu sebelum penemuan lampau ('did they uncover') memakai 'had been excavating'.
hints: Penemuan terjadi di masa lalu ('did they uncover').
Penggalian selama 3 minggu terjadi sebelum momen itu.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyatukan hasil terhitung pasti dengan Past Perfect Continuous berikut.
complex.draft: By midnight, the volunteer call center had been answering over six hundred emergency inquiries.
options: By midnight, the volunteer call center had answered over six hundred emergency inquiries.
By midnight, the volunteer call center has answered over six hundred emergency inquiries.
By midnight, the volunteer call center had been answered over six hundred emergency inquiries.
complex.explanation: Begitu jumlah tuntas ('over six hundred emergency inquiries') disebutkan sebagai pencapaian hingga batas 'By midnight', gunakan Past Perfect Simple ('had answered'), bukan Continuous.
hints: Ada jumlah hasil pasti ('over six hundred...').
Angka pencapaian selesai memakai Past Perfect Simple.

complex.prompt: He complained that the air-conditioning unit ___ making a metallic rattle all week before maintenance checked it.
complex.explanation: Reported complaint tentang kebisingan berulang sebelum pengecekan di masa lalu memakai Past Perfect Continuous ('had been making').
hints: Komplain lampau merujuk pada gangguan seminggu penuh sebelumnya.
Pakai 'had been'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi formal berpola 'Scarcely' dalam Past Perfect Continuous.
complex.targetSentence: Scarcely had we been testing the prototype for an hour when a relay overheated.
complex.explanation: Hanya 'had' pindah sebelum subjek 'we', diikuti 'been testing... when + Past Simple'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Scarcely had we been testing'.
Sambungkan dengan 'when a relay overheated'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan tidak langsung (reported speech) dari Present Perfect Continuous.
complex.targetSentence: Dr. Lin noted that the coastal team had been tracking salinity levels since March.
complex.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous ('have been tracking') berubah menjadi 'had been tracking' setelah 'noted that'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Dr. Lin noted that the coastal team'.
Gunakan 'had been tracking salinity levels since March'.
